data.body: AC amendment: 1) cited_lines_fingerprint algorithm must be explicitly specified: SHA-256 of LF-normalized, trailing-whitespace-stripped concatenation of '<path>:<line_number>:<content>' per cited line, encoded as UTF-8 bytes, output as lowercase hex. Add: Verify: grep -q 'SHA-256\|sha256\|sha_256' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md && grep -q 'UTF-8\|utf-8\|unicode\|codepoint' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md. 2) defense_text 4096-char cap: contract MUST specify unit (Unicode codepoints) and over-cap behavior (reject with error vs truncate-with-truncation-marker). Add: Verify: grep -q 'codepoint\|Unicode\|4096' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md.
